mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses risk-free rates, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 7.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 7.0%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.0%) and accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) create a 'growth-at-risk' environment where equity valuations rise, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.0% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or interaction term Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, declining housing starts (HOUST < 600.0) signal weakening residential demand, reducing construction sector activity and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 600.0 during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO < 105.0) signals manufacturing slowdown, reducing corporate output and profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 105.0, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rising consumer spending (RSAFS > 340.0) and elevated unemployment (UNRATE > 7.0%) indicate stagflationary pressures, reducing corporate profit visibility and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 340.0 and UNRATE > 7.0%, or interaction term Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts above 650.0 signals strong residential demand, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 650.0, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles, a federal funds rate above 0.5% increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5% during monetary tightening, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.
